blank: you will tell me this proverb, '___, heal yourself!'
gloss: 醫者不自醫，諷刺言行不一的人
usage: 現代英語常引用 physician, heal yourself 諷刺那些教導別人卻無法以身作則的人

text: pressed down, shaken together, and running over
blank: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and ___ over, will be given to you
usage: 現代英語（尤其談論慷慨或回報時）仍引用 pressed down, shaken together and running over 形容豐盛滿溢的回報

text: put his hand to the plow
blank: no one, having put his hand to the ___ and looking back, is fit for God's Kingdom
gloss: 著手做事卻又猶豫回頭
usage: 現代英語仍用 put your hand to the plow 比喻一旦著手做重要的事就不該回頭猶豫

text: passed by on the other side
blank: when he saw him, he passed by on the ___ side
gloss: 視而不見，冷漠迴避（有需要幫助的人）
usage: 現代英語常用 pass by on the other side 形容對他人的困境視而不見、冷漠迴避

blank: take your ease, eat, drink, and be ___
usage: 現代英語極常用 eat, drink and be merry 表示及時行樂、享受當下

text: to whom much is given, of him will much be required
blank: to whomever much is given, of him will much be ___
gloss: 被賦予越多，被要求或期望的責任也越大
usage: 現代英語（商業、政治語境）常引用 to whom much is given, much will be required 強調享有優勢者應承擔相對責任

text: sit down and count the cost
blank: doesn't first sit down and ___ the cost
usage: 現代英語常用 count the cost 表示在行動前先評估可能付出的代價

blank: but when he came to ___, he said
usage: 現代英語仍用 come to oneself 表示如夢初醒、恢復理智看清現實

blank: bring the fattened calf, ___ it, and let's eat and celebrate
gloss: 殺牛慶祝，盛大款待、隆重歡迎
usage: 現代英語常引用 kill the fatted calf 比喻為慶祝或歡迎而大肆款待

blank: between us and you there is a great gulf ___
usage: 現代英語（尤其正式或政治語境）仍用 a great gulf fixed between 形容雙方之間存在無法彌合的巨大分歧

gloss: 警惕貪戀過去、回頭張望的下場
usage: 現代英語仍引用 remember Lot's wife 警告人不要留戀應該放下的過去

blank: but beat his ___, saying, 'God, be merciful to me, a sinner!'
gloss: 捶胸頓足，表達強烈懊悔
usage: 現代英語仍用 beat one's chest 形容強烈自責懊悔（或誇張地自我標榜）的姿態

text: out of your own mouth I will judge you
blank: out of your own ___ I will judge you, you wicked servant!
gloss: 以其人之言定其罪，自打嘴巴
usage: 現代英語偶爾引用 condemned out of your own mouth 表示某人的言論反成為對自己不利的證據

blank: if these were silent, the stones would cry ___
gloss: 連石頭都會忍不住呼喊，喻真相勢不可擋
usage: 現代英語偶爾引用 even the stones will cry out 形容真相或不公之事已經明顯到無法被壓制

text: Father, forgive them, for they don't know what they are doing
blank: Father, forgive them, for they don't ___ what they are doing
usage: 現代英語廣泛引用 forgive them, for they know not what they do 表達對無知犯錯者的寬恕

blank: weren't our hearts ___ within us while he spoke to us
gloss: 內心澎湃激動、深受感動
usage: 現代英語仍用 our hearts were burning within us 形容深受感動、內心澎湃激動的感覺
